rawContent: ELEVEN more women have accused opera legend PLACIDO DOMINGO of sexual assault - a month after a report emerged in which several others claimed he made inappropriate advances - Before the #MeToo Movement you touched a lady, so be it - You didn't go to jail for touching someone....

He's ruining their Zen - RUSSELL SIMMONS might be trying to make a comeback - after being dragged through the mud in the #MeToo movement amid 12 accusations of rape & sexual misconduct - but a yoga studio says he's nothing but a downward-facing dog

The assistant to tough guy ROBERT DI NERO, GRAHAM CHASE ROBINSON, says the actor would berate her, swear at her & make sexual comments - Sounds like he's creepy & abusive - The #MeToo people need to get into gear & get on this abusive, ugly man!

German waitresses participating in the country's traditional OKTOBERFEST are employing a novel approach - They are now wearing cycling shorts under their dirndl dresses to better protect themselves from unwanted touching - Does the #MeToo Movement have a branch in Germany?

Millennials live most of their lives online, so it's only natural that their sex lives have gone digital, as well - Rep. KATIE HILL's (Dem. Cali) case illuminates the tricky nuances of workplace relationships in the #MeToo era - No staffers, have accused her of any wrongdoing

"Baby It's Cold Outside", the traditional Christmas song, has had the lyrics re-written & the new version, to put it mildly, is extremely CHILLY - The new song lovebirds are JOHN LEGEND  & KELLY CLARKSON - The singers' #MeToo-inspired version do NOT hit the spot at all!

Not ALL women care:  Disgraced movie mogul HARVEY WEINSTEIN isn't letting sex-assault charges get in the way of his fun - He was spotted partying at an exclusive lounge with actress ALEXANDRA VINO, who was dancing seductively for him & even sitting on his lap - Now what #MeToo?
